name: Kastin
description: Kastin, also known as OM811, was a barren rock planet with no moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.
lead_paragraphs: Kastin, also known as OM811, was a barren rock planet with no moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.
